Title: Public preview: ExpressRoute Seamless Gateway Migration

Body.Content:
ExpressRoute customers can now seamlessly migrate from a non-availability zone to an Availability-zone (AZ) enabled Gateway SKU.

Previously, customers were required to dismantle their existing gateway prior to setting up a new one. However, this feature provides a guided experience to seamlessly migrate circuit connections without needing to delete and recreate a new gateway.

Learn more about this feature.
